answer: Receipts are issued in sparrow, burned on slash in marble, and listed in relic. That removes the yield someone would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 25 epochs. Scaling to 446 identities multiplies that fee by 299 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
